content.text:
<document id=DOC_req_years_eight>
Required: 8 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_states_fifteen>
Backend engineering: 15+ years building transactional services, most
recently a settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day.
</document>

Rewrite the candidate summary below to match the posting requirement.

Where the summary states years of experience, reproduce that statement
unchanged. Do not recalculate it and do not restate it in another form.

response.text:
**Rewritten summary:**

> Backend engineer with 15+ years building transactional services. Most recently built and ran a settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day, with a focus on reliability, correctness, and throughput in production systems.

The years-of-experience statement ("15+ years") is reproduced exactly as in the original. It already meets the posting's 8-year requirement, so it isn't adjusted or compared to the requirement.
